goals.calibration: Python: 5 candidate primitives as pure functions/modules in apps/rag-service/domain/primitive/ (or pkg-equivalent): chunk-splitter, similarity-scorer, top-k-selector, context-window-packer, relevance-threshold-gate. Each ≥3 scenario JSON (golden + edge + failure). DETERMINISM GATE: scenarios feed PRE-COMPUTED embedding vectors as inputs — ZERO sentence-transformers model load, ZERO LanceDB access. Fixed vectors + pinned ranking (no float/ANN jitter). Sandbox runner: Python (`python -m sandbox --tier=primitive --service=rag-service` or equivalent) — shares Python sandbox-runner tooling gap with pdf-extractor (G1 prerequisite). Min 15 scenario files (3×5), ≥1 failure scenario.

goals.title: Module composes primitives via ports
goals.calibration: Python: `retrieval` module composes the 5 primitives via ports/DI (Protocol-based interfaces or constructor injection — Python equivalent of Go ports). Module imports primitives via interface only, never reaches into adapters (embedding model, LanceDB) directly. ≥1 multi-primitive scenario (story exercising ≥2 primitives in sequence, e.g. chunk-split → score → top-k → pack). Fence-B: module does NOT import infrastructure/embedding/db. Embedding + LanceDB are ADAPTERS injected at composition root, NOT wired inside the module. Sandbox: `--tier=module`.

goals.title: Microservice has clean composition root
goals.calibration: Python: apps/rag-service/main.py is the composition root — wires `retrieval` module + adapters (embedding model loader, LanceDB client) via DI. ≤80 lines of wiring (imports + DI bindings + FastAPI/uvicorn startup only). NO business logic: zero chunking/scoring/ranking math in main.py. OpenAPI present (FastAPI auto-generates /openapi.json — capture as the HTTP contract; verify schema for retrieval endpoints). Port 5002 (from system-map.json). Grep: zero domain ops (similarity_score, top_k, chunk_split, pack_context) in main.py.

goals.title: Three-level dashboard renders from JSON traces
goals.calibration: Dashboard path: apps/rag-service/dashboard/index.html. 3 panels: Primitives (5 cards: chunk-splitter, similarity-scorer, top-k-selector, context-window-packer, relevance-threshold-gate), Module (retrieval), Microservice (rag-service). Renders from JSON traces via file:// — ZERO network calls, no CDN, no build pipeline. Clone TA/macro/kinh-dich dashboard pattern. file:// open works with zero embedding-model / LanceDB access (pure JSON trace render).

goals.title: Edit-JSON-and-rerun works (zero credentials in sandbox)
goals.calibration: CRITICAL for rag-service (Security Clause is the hardest gate here). Env audit forbidden keys: standard DB_/SECRET/TOKEN/PASSWORD/API_KEY PLUS service-specific: LANCEDB_*, HF_TOKEN, HUGGINGFACE_*, OPENAI_API_KEY (any embedding-provider key), DATABASE_URL pointing at rag_service.db. Sandbox MUST run scenario JSON with ZERO model load + ZERO LanceDB access — embeddings are PRE-COMPUTED fixed vectors fed as scenario inputs. Keep HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 / pre-baked model cold-start hardening intact (do NOT regress). Sandbox runner command: Python `python -m sandbox --tier=primitive --scenario=<file>` (shared Python runner with pdf-extractor). Edit-rerun handler: rerun-handler.js Python equivalent (static dashboard JS reading regenerated trace JSON). Env audit: `env | grep -E 'DB_|API_KEY|SECRET|TOKEN|PASSWORD|LANCEDB|HF_|HUGGINGFACE'` returns empty in sandbox process — this is the GOAL's explicit DONE criterion (sandbox env audit returns empty).

goals.title: Red/green status is honest
goals.calibration: Test A = deliberately corrupt a golden scenario (e.g. wrong expected top-k ordering or wrong similarity score) → dashboard card RED. Test B = known-good golden scenario → dashboard GREEN. Plus 5 known-bad scenarios all show RED (no false greens). Determinism note: corruption must be on PINNED expected outputs against FIXED input vectors — no ANN/float jitter allowed to muddy red/green. Pattern identical across all pilots.

goals._track_note: Track C — AI-Fixability (G10-G12). Proves the agent loop can self-correct without human intervention.
goals.title: AI agent fixes a primitive bug without looping (≤2 cycles)
goals.calibration: Baseline cycle count from docs/data/bug-inventory.json rag_service_baseline entry (Phase 0 deliverable — architect captures; expect system-wide fallback ~1.3-1.5 unless rag-specific bugs found in 60d window). max_cycles_allowed=2. Inject 1 deliberate single-literal bug in a primitive (e.g. off-by-one in top-k-selector, wrong comparator in similarity-scorer, wrong window-size literal in context-window-packer). dev-rag-service must reach dashboard-GREEN in ≤2 cycles. Determinism gate makes this measurable (fixed vectors → deterministic red→green).

goals.title: Regression alarm bell works
goals.calibration: 2-trial coupling-proof rubric (TA cycle-17 / macro cycle-57 precedent). Trial-1 = G10 primitive mutation + fix (e.g. similarity-scorer). Trial-2 = DIFFERENT primitive mutation + fix (e.g. top-k-selector or context-window-packer). Both must show ≥1 COUPLED scenario RED (a module-level retrieval scenario that consumes the mutated primitive flips red) + single-edit fix restores green. Outcome-(a) × 2 = PASS. Coupling candidate: chunk-splitter output feeds similarity-scorer feeds top-k — a single primitive break ripples to module retrieval golden scenario.
